newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Petrofina unit finds more gas off Vietnam.
newsitem.headline: Petrofina unit finds more gas off Vietnam.

text.p: Belgian oil group Petrofina SA said on Monday its unit Fina Exploration Minh Hai, as operator of a joint venture with SODEC Vietnam, had announced a third discovery of gas and condensate off the shore of Vietnam.

It said the discovery was made in Block 51 located offshore to the south west of Vietnam. Fina Exploration Minh Hai has a 75 percent interest in Block 51, and SODEC Vietnam - an affiliate of Showa Shell - has the remaining 25 percent.
In a statement, Petrofina said well 51-UM-IX flowed at an aggregate rate of 36.4 million cubic feet of gas a day and 500 barrels a day of condensate.
It added that if the field was developed, the Vietnamese state company, PetroVietnam, would have the option to acquire a stake of up to 15 percent in it.
